jsonld_description: A free, open-source desktop app for downloading YouTube video as MP4 or audio as MP3, plus 1,800+ other sites. Fast and native on macOS, Windows, and Linux — powered by yt-dlp.
eyebrow: Free & open source · macOS · Windows · Linux
hero_lead: A fast, native desktop app for downloading video and audio from YouTube and 1,800+ other sites — powered by yt-dlp, built with Tauri.
hero_img_alt: KeepMeTube download manager showing a list of completed and in-progress downloads with size, date, and progress columns
compare_lead: KeepMeTube follows your system theme automatically, or you can lock in light or dark yourself. Drag the handle to see both.
queue_desc: Progress, transfer speed, and history for every download, newest first — filter the list, retry a failed one, or drill into a playlist's queue.
queue_img_dark_alt: KeepMeTube download queue in dark mode
queue_img_light_alt: The same download queue in light mode
queue_slider_aria: Drag to compare light and dark mode for the download queue
modal_desc: Pick a resolution and container, then attach cookies for age-restricted or member-only content. Paste one link or several — the field can even auto-fill from your clipboard.
modal_img_dark_alt: KeepMeTube add-download dialog in dark mode, with cookie authentication and resolution controls
modal_img_light_alt: The same add-download dialog in light mode
modal_slider_aria: Drag to compare light and dark mode for the add-download dialog
compare_note: Shown in Türkçe — one of the 10 languages built into KeepMeTube.
playlists_lead: Paste a playlist link and KeepMeTube analyzes it, so you can pick exactly which videos to grab and queue them all at once. Each playlist collapses into a single row in your download list — with a drill-down view for what's queued — and saves into its own subfolder, named after the playlist.
playlist_shot1_alt: Add Download dialog showing an analyzed YouTube playlist named Damnation with 8 videos listed and all selected for download
playlist_shot1_caption: Pick what you want. KeepMeTube reads the whole playlist and lists every video — select all, or just the ones you need, before queuing.
playlist_shot2_alt: Download list drilled into the Damnation playlist, showing all 8 tracks completed with individual file size and progress
playlist_shot2_caption: Grouped, not scattered. Playlists collapse into one row in your download list; drill in to see each track's own progress and status.
features_lead: Everything yt-dlp can do, without touching a terminal.
feature_1_desc: YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook, Vimeo, SoundCloud, and nearly everywhere else yt-dlp reaches.
feature_2_desc: Checks for yt-dlp updates on launch and upgrades in one click, so new sites and formats keep working.
feature_3_desc: Attach a cookies.txt to pull age-restricted, member-only, or private content using your own logged-in session.
feature_4_desc: English, Türkçe, Español, Français, Deutsch, Português, العربية, 日本語, 한국어, and 中文 — built in, not bolted on.
feature_5_desc: Matches your OS automatically, or set it yourself — see it for yourself just above.
feature_6_desc: Real percentage, transfer speed, and status for every download, updating as it happens.
feature_7_desc: Downloads run automatically, up to a limit you choose — the rest wait their turn.
feature_8_desc: Your download list survives restarts — nothing disappears when you close the app.
feature_9_desc: Rename, reveal in Finder or Explorer, or delete finished downloads without leaving the app.
feature_10_desc: Paste a playlist link, pick exactly which videos to grab, and queue them all — grouped into one row, saved into their own subfolder.
feature_11_desc: Queue several links at once, or let KeepMeTube auto-fill the URL from your clipboard.
feature_12_desc: Grab subtitles, embed the thumbnail, and write title and artist metadata into the file — all optional, per download.
feature_13_desc: Filter a long download list as you type, and retry any failed download with one click.
feature_14_desc: Choose a default save folder and filename template, and set how many downloads run at once.
showcase_lead: Every screen is built from the same flat, hairline-bordered system — nothing borrowed, nothing generic.
shot1_alt: Add Download dialog in English and dark mode, showing a connected cookies.txt file and a 1080p resolution selector
shot1_caption: Cookies & format control. Authenticate once, then choose resolution, container, and video-or-audio per download.
shot2_alt: Download list in light mode with an active download at 9.1 percent and a transfer speed of 11.92 MiB per second
shot2_caption: Numbers you can trust. Percentage and speed are read straight from yt-dlp's own output, live.
shot3_alt: KeepMeTube settings panel showing default download location, filename template, and concurrent downloads controls
shot3_caption: Your defaults, your way. Set a default save folder, a filename template, and how many downloads run at once.
download_lead_fallback: Free, open source, no account required.
callout_p1: macOS says the app is “damaged”? It isn't — KeepMeTube isn't notarized by Apple yet, so Gatekeeper flags any download from outside the App Store by default.
